title: Rapamycin (sirolimus) as a steroid-sparing agent in dermatomyositis.
source_type: Journal of the American Academy of Dermatology
text_summary: 皮肌炎是一种自身免疫性疾病，通过对肌肉和皮肤的影响导致显着的发病率和死亡率。皮质类固醇是皮肌炎的主要治疗方法，严重的发病率和死亡率部分是由于长期使用类固醇的已知长期副作用而发生的。此外，皮肌炎通常与潜在的恶性肿瘤有关，高剂量的类固醇可能会对这些恶性肿瘤的治疗产生不利影响。我们描述了雷帕霉素在年轻皮肌炎患者中的首次使用。

Rapamycin (sirolimus) as a steroid-sparing
             agent in dermatomyositis

                   Uma Nadiminti, MD, and Jack L. Arbiser, MD, PhD
                                            Atlanta, Georgia


    Dermatomyositis is an autoimmune condition that results in signiﬁcant morbidity and mortality through
     effects on muscle and skin. Corticosteroids are the mainstay of therapy of dermatomyositis, and severe
    morbidity and mortality occurs in part through the known long-term side effects of chronic steroid use. In
    addition, dermatomyositis is commonly associated with underlying malignancy, and high-dose steroids
   may adversely impair treatment of these malignancies. We describe the ﬁrst use of rapamycin in a young
    patient with dermatomyositis. ( J Am Acad Dermatol 2005;52:S17-9.)
